card.name: Partway through words before "ang"
card.fires_on: Responds partway through a word when the next piece is likely to be "ang" or "an", as in harangued, cliffhanger, boomerangs, or the brand names Wellbutrin and Normosol. It also fires on the P of HERPES in all-caps headings.

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: Inside drug brand names, such as Wellbutrin or Normosol, in all caps or normal case.

modes.label: Ordinary words
modes.description: Partway through ordinary English words that continue with "ang", such as harangued, cliffhanger, or boomerangs.

card.writes: It promotes continuations that start with "ang", although several words in the contexts do not actually continue that way.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of certain longer words, such as brand names and words like harangue or boomerang, where a piece like "ang" may come next.
